beats.summary: Kelly and Ryan announce their recent marriage and immediate divorce, revealing it was impulsive and amicable at first but then turns into a request for sides.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: Over the weekend, Ryan Bailey Howard and I got divorced.
Ryan & Kelly: I don't think I should be married to you anymore.

beats.summary: Ryan expresses his opposition to marriage until everyone can be married, causing tension with Kelly and others.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: No, with the messed up laws in this country, I don't want to be married until everyone can be married.
Kelly: Ryan, I changed my mind.

beats.summary: Michael and Holly discuss their uncertain relationship status and differing views on when to start dating again.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Well, those things that you consider doodles, I consider art.

beats.summary: Jim receives an urgent call from Helene about their baby Cece being locked in the car with a fever, prompting him to rush to her.

evidence.snippet: Helene: A tiny thing. I locked her in the car.

evidence.snippet: Attendant: No, he ditched you man. I saw him drive away.
